lyrics.original: 日が暮れとぼとぼ 暗い家に着いた
lyrics.romanization: hi ga kure tobotobo kurai ie ni tsuita
lyrics.english: Night fell, I trudged into my dark home

lyrics.original: 君はいないよ でもなぜか暖かい
lyrics.romanization: kimi wa inai yo demo nazeka atatakai
lyrics.english: You're not here but it somehow feels warm

lyrics.original: 「ただいま」とか「いただきます」とか
lyrics.romanization: "tadaima" toka "itadakimasu" toka
lyrics.english: "I'm home" or "Bon appétit"

lyrics.original: ひとりで言うのも 君のせいで平気
lyrics.romanization: hitori de iu no mo kimi no sei de heiki
lyrics.english: I say to myself, but it's okay because of you

lyrics.original: 冷蔵庫開け 少し残ってたMILK
lyrics.romanization: reizouko ake sukoshi nokotteta milk
lyrics.english: Open the fridge, there's a bit of milk left

lyrics.original: 飲もうとした時 ふとこう思ったんだ
lyrics.romanization: nomou to shita toki futo kou omottanda
lyrics.english: I reach for it then I think to myself

lyrics.original: 感情の消費期限 いつまでだろう？
lyrics.romanization: kanjou no shouhi kigen itsu made darou?
lyrics.english: What's the use-by date on love?

lyrics.original: ずっとこの感情のままでいたい
lyrics.romanization: zutto kono kanjou no mama de itai
lyrics.english: Cuz I want to stay this way forever

lyrics.original: ここにいるよ 僕は 変わらない心で
lyrics.romanization: koko ni iru yo boku wa kawaranai kokoro de
lyrics.english: I am here, my heart unwavering

lyrics.original: ここにいるよ 僕は ここに
lyrics.romanization: koko ni iru yo boku wa koko ni
lyrics.english: I am here I am

lyrics.original: いくつもの過去と未来
lyrics.romanization: ikutsu mo no kako to mirai
lyrics.english: Countless pasts and futures

lyrics.original: 見えなくても大丈夫さ
lyrics.romanization: mienakute mo daijoubu sa
lyrics.english: It's okay even if I can't see them

lyrics.original: どんな日でも 見つめあって 笑うことができるなら
lyrics.romanization: donna hi demo mitsumeatte warau koto ga dekiru nara
lyrics.english: As long as I can lock eyes with you and smile

lyrics.original: 突然降り出した雨に 濡れた君を両手で
lyrics.romanization: totsuzen furidashita ame ni nureta kimi wo ryoute de
lyrics.english: When you're drenched from the sudden shower

lyrics.original: 抱きしめてあげる 僕ならできるから
lyrics.romanization: dakishimete ageru boku nara dekiru kara
lyrics.english: I'll wrap you in my arms because I can
